RESOLVED_MODULE:M108:Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Slope
BEGIN_SIGNATURE:M108
@hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_zero : ∀ {𝕜 : Type u} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField.{u} 𝕜] {F : Type v} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup.{v} F]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace.{u, v} 𝕜 F] {f : 𝕜 → F} {f' : F} {x : 𝕜},
  HasDerivAt.{u, v} f f' x ↔
    Filter.Tendsto.{u, v}
      (fun t => HSMul.hSMul.{u, v, v} (Inv.inv.{u} t) (HSub.hSub.{v, v, v} (f (HAdd.hAdd.{u, u, u} x t)) (f x)))
      (nhdsWithin.{u} 0 (compl.{u} (singleton.{u, u} 0))) (nhds.{v} f')
BEGIN_AXIOMS:M108
'hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_zero' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice.{u}, Quot.sound.{u}]
